info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Finance Financial Statement By Financial Statement Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Fetch Financial Statement API allows users to retrieve detailed financial statements based on a specific financial statement ID. This API is essential for clients needing to access historical financial data for reporting and analysis. Typical consumers include financial analysts, accountants, and business managers who require insights into financial performance. The operation enables users to seamlessly integrate financial data into their applications or reporting tools, promoting efficiency and informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a specific financial statement using its unique identifier. It returns detailed information about the financial statement, which can be used for analysis and reporting purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the financial statements associated with the specified record. Ensure that the request complies with the expected schema to receive the desired data effectively.
